name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Fixes federated content sticking around forever after a friend is disconnected by any means other than the admin-triggered Remove button. Every prune of a server's cached items previously only ever ran as part of actively syncing that specific server, or an explicit admin delete - once a server was gone from config some other way (confirmed live this session: a raw config save that dropped a RemoteServers entry), nothing ever revisited its now-orphaned cache entries again, since the sync loop only iterates currently-configured servers. Thousands of items from a friend removed hours earlier were still sitting in the library. Every sync now sweeps cache entries for any server id no longer in config at all before reconciling, regardless of how it disappeared - so their content actually goes away on the very next sync instead of needing a full server reset.

215 tests (up from 214).
